mapper.select: select r.tenant_id, r.is_default from rm_user_tenant_rela_t r join sym_tenant_t t on t.tid = r.tenant_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.is_del = 0 and t.status = 1 and t.is_del = 0 order by r.is_default desc, t.sort_no, t.created_time
select tenant_id, is_default from rm_user_tenant_rela_t where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 and is_del = 0 order by is_default desc

select r.tenant_id from rm_user_tenant_rela_t r join sym_tenant_t t on t.tid = r.tenant_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.status = 1 and r.is_del = 0 and t.status = 1 and t.is_del = 0

select t.tid tenant_id, t.code, t.name, t.status, t.init_flag, r.is_default from rm_user_tenant_rela_t r join sym_tenant_t t on t.tid = r.tenant_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.is_del = 0 and t.is_del = 0 order by r.is_default desc, t.sort_no, t.created_time
